item.tib: gsang sngags ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs
item.coloph: ces bla ma'i rnal 'byor seng ge 'gying ba'i sgra dbyangs dang / yi dam rnal 'byor bdud rtsi bum pa'i mgul rgyan dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i rnal 'byor yid dga' nor bu dpal 'dzin zhes bya ba 'di/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis sa glang zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu la/ thar (ya ta) tshang gi phu g.ya' tshan zhal dkar gyi mdun 'bri stod sa gnas g.ya' dkar ral pa g.ya' za 'og dpal 'dzing zhes bya ba'i mdun der brtsams pa dge legs 'phel//
